# What this script does

50 km alternative to `marine_ngo_per_capita.qmd`. Uses **`marine_and_inland50.gpkg`** for both NGO clipping and the coastal population denominator (same join logic as the 10 km script, but intersected with the 50 km layer).

**Inputs:** `script1_denue_marine_ngo_prep.qmd` → `marine_ngos_2019_2026_goc_50km.gpkg`

**Outputs**

- `marine_ngo_units_per_pop_by_region_year_50km.csv`
- `marine_ngo_units_per_pop_current_status_75th_quantile_50km.csv`
- `marine_ngo_employees_per_pop_current_status_75th_quantile_50km.csv`

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(plotly)
library(janitor)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

int_dir <- here::here(
  "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/sp/cce/v2026/int/marine_ngos"
)
output_dir <- here::here(
  "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/sp/cce/v2026/output"
)
dir.create(int_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ngo_gpkg <- here::here(int_dir, "marine_ngos_2019_2026_goc_50km.gpkg")
ngo_shp <- here::here(int_dir, "marine_ngos_2019_2026_goc_50km.shp")
ngo_path <- if (file.exists(ngo_gpkg)) ngo_gpkg else ngo_shp

if (!file.exists(ngo_path)) {
  stop(
    "Run script1_denue_marine_ngo_prep.qmd first. Expected: ", ngo_gpkg
  )
}

rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

fix_denue_text <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("<fa>", "ú") %>%
    str_replace_all("<e1>", "á") %>%
    str_replace_all("<ed>", "í") %>%
    str_replace_all("<f1>", "ñ") %>%
    str_replace_all("<e9>", "é")
}

clean_municipio <- function(municipio_raw) {
  municipio_fixed <- fix_denue_text(municipio_raw)
  municipio_lower <- municipio_fixed %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all(" ", "_")
  case_when(
    municipio_fixed == "San Ignacio Río Muerto" ~ "cajeme",
    municipio_fixed == "Bácum" ~ "cajeme",
    municipio_fixed == "Mexicali" ~ "san_felipe",
    municipio_fixed == "Sinaloa" ~ "guasave",
    municipio_fixed == "Santa María del Oro" ~ "san_pedro_lagunillas",
    TRUE ~ municipio_lower
  )
}

employees_from_per_ocu <- function(per_ocu) {
  case_when(
    per_ocu == "0 a 5 personas" ~ 3,
    per_ocu == "6 a 10 personas" ~ 8,
    per_ocu == "11 a 30 personas" ~ 20.5,
    per_ocu == "31 a 50 personas" ~ 40.5,
    per_ocu == "51 a 100 personas" ~ 75.5,
    per_ocu == "101 a 250 personas" ~ 175.5,
    per_ocu %in% c("251 y m<e1>s personas", "251 y más personas") ~ 300,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
```

# 1. Read marine NGOs and summarize by municipio

```{r}
marine_ngo_gulf_50km <- st_read(ngo_path, quiet = TRUE)

marine_ngo_places <- marine_ngo_gulf_50km %>%
  mutate(
    nom_estab = fix_denue_text(nom_estab),
    nombre_act = fix_denue_text(nombre_act),
    municipio = fix_denue_text(municipio),
    municipio_clean = clean_municipio(municipio),
    employees_estimated = if ("employees_estimated" %in% names(.)) {
      employees_estimated
    } else {
      employees_from_per_ocu(per_ocu)
    }
  )

marine_ngo_gulf_50km_clean <- marine_ngo_places %>%
  group_by(municipio_clean, data_year, rgn_id) %>%
  summarize(
    agg_employees = sum(employees_estimated, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_units = length(unique(id)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

marine_ngo_gulf_50km_clean
```

# 2. Coastal population in the 50 km buffer

```{r}
goc50_candidates <- c(
  "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/OHI_regions/marine_and_inland50.gpkg",
  "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/ohi_regions/marine_and_inland50.gpkg",
  here::here("spatial", "OHI_regions", "marine_and_inland50.gpkg"),
  here::here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "marine_and_inland50.gpkg")
)
goc50_path <- goc50_candidates[file.exists(goc50_candidates)][1]

pop_candidates <- c(
  "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/pressures/population_localities/inegi_boundaries_pop.shp",
  here::here("goal_prep", "pressures", "population_localities", "inegi_boundaries_pop.shp")
)
pop_path <- pop_candidates[file.exists(pop_candidates)][1]

if (is.na(goc50_path) || is.na(pop_path)) {
  stop("Could not find marine_and_inland50.gpkg or INEGI locality population shapefile.")
}

goc50 <- st_read(goc50_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_make_valid()

cities <- st_read(pop_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  clean_names()

cities_clean <- st_intersection(st_transform(cities, st_crs(goc50)), goc50) %>%
  mutate(municipio = fix_denue_text(nom_mun)) %>%
  mutate(municipio_clean = clean_municipio(municipio)) %>%
  dplyr::select(municipio_clean, rgn_id, pobtot, area_km2, pobtot_km2)
```

# 3. Join NGOs with population (same inner join as 10 km script)

```{r}
marine_ngo_clean_join <- marine_ngo_gulf_50km_clean %>% st_drop_geometry()

cities_clean_join <- cities_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(municipio_clean) %>%
  summarize(
    pobtot = sum(pobtot),
    area_km2 = sum(area_km2),
    pobtot_km2 = sum(pobtot_km2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

join_ngo_pop_50km <- inner_join(marine_ngo_clean_join, cities_clean_join)

join_ngo_pop_50km
```

# 4. Scale to population by region and year

```{r}
marine_ngo_scaled_to_population <- join_ngo_pop_50km %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, data_year) %>%
  summarize(
    agg_employees = sum(agg_employees),
    n_units = sum(n_units),
    pobtot = sum(pobtot),
    area_km2 = sum(area_km2),
    pobtot_km2 = sum(pobtot_km2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ngo_emp_per_local_pop = agg_employees / pobtot,
    ngo_units_per_local_pop = n_units / pobtot
  )

write_csv(
  marine_ngo_scaled_to_population,
  here::here(int_dir, "marine_ngo_units_per_pop_by_region_year_50km.csv")
)

marine_ngo_scaled_to_population
```

```{r}
plot_ly(
  marine_ngo_scaled_to_population,
  x = ~data_year,
  y = ~ngo_units_per_local_pop,
  color = ~rgn_id,
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Marine NGOs: economic units per coastal resident (50 km buffer)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "units / coastal population")
  )
```

# 5. Current status (75th quantile reference, capped at 100)

```{r}
marine_ngo_units_75th <- marine_ngo_scaled_to_population %>%
  mutate(
    percap_75th = quantile(ngo_units_per_local_pop, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    current_status = (ngo_units_per_local_pop / percap_75th) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(score = if_else(current_status > 100, 100, current_status))

marine_ngo_emp_75th <- marine_ngo_scaled_to_population %>%
  mutate(
    percap_75th = quantile(ngo_emp_per_local_pop, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    current_status = (ngo_emp_per_local_pop / percap_75th) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(score = if_else(current_status > 100, 100, current_status))

write_csv(
  marine_ngo_units_75th,
  here::here(
    output_dir,
    "marine_ngo_units_per_pop_current_status_75th_quantile_50km.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  marine_ngo_emp_75th,
  here::here(
    output_dir,
    "marine_ngo_employees_per_pop_current_status_75th_quantile_50km.csv"
  )
)

marine_ngo_units_75th %>%
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, data_year, n_units, pobtot, ngo_units_per_local_pop, current_status, score) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, data_year)
```

```{r}
plot_ly(
  marine_ngo_units_75th,
  x = ~data_year,
  y = ~score,
  color = ~rgn_id,
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "CURRENT STATUS: marine NGOs per capita, 50 km (75th quantile reference)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Score (0-100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    x = range(marine_ngo_units_75th$data_year),
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Goal (100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
```

# 6. Spot-check table for EWG review

```{r}
marine_ngo_places %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    data_year, rgn_id, municipio_clean, id, nom_estab, nombre_act, per_ocu
  ) %>%
  arrange(data_year, rgn_id, nom_estab) %>%
  write_csv(here::here(int_dir, "marine_ngo_spotcheck_for_review_50km.csv"))

marine_ngo_places %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(data_year, rgn_id, nombre_act, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)
```
